meta.title: The Cursed Island
meta.subtitle: 🏴‍☠️ A lost island filled with treasure… and something far worse.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 🌫 Land Ho
scenes.narrative:
Your ship creaks as it approaches a fog-covered island.

🏝 Legends claim no crew who landed here ever returned.

But they also speak of unimaginable treasure hidden deep within.

⚓ Your crew waits nervously for your command.

scenes.title: 🏖 The Silent Shore
scenes.narrative:
You step onto the beach.

No birds.
No footprints.
No sound except the waves.

🌴 A dense jungle waits ahead while a shattered shipwreck rests along the shore.

scenes.title: 🪨 Jagged Cliffs
scenes.narrative:
You sail around the island and discover towering cliffs.

🌊 Hidden at water level is a narrow sea cave.

The tide is low enough to enter… for now.

scenes.title: 🚣 Scouting Party
scenes.narrative:
You send several sailors ashore.

Minutes pass.

Then an hour.

Eventually the boat drifts back toward your ship… empty.

⚠️ Something is wrong on that island.

scenes.title: 🚢 The Wreck
scenes.narrative:
The remains of an old ship lie scattered across the sand.

📖 Inside the ruined cabin, you discover a weathered journal and a rusted key.

scenes.title: ⚠️ The Warning
scenes.narrative:
The journal describes a cursed treasure guarded by something that cannot die.

The final entry is written shakily across the page:

"DO NOT TAKE THE GOLD."

scenes.title: 🌴 The Jungle Path
scenes.narrative:
The jungle is thick, humid, and strangely quiet.

🌿 Strange noises echo between the trees.

Ahead, the trail splits.

🏛 One path leads toward ancient ruins.
🕳 The other disappears into a dark cave.

scenes.title: 🌊 The Sea Cave
scenes.narrative:
Inside the cave, glowing algae illuminates the walls with eerie blue light.

⚓ You dock your ship beside a hidden tunnel leading deeper into the island.

scenes.title: 🏛 Ancient Ruins
scenes.narrative:
Massive stone ruins rise from the jungle floor.

🌿 Vines cover broken statues and ancient carvings.

At the center stands a giant locked stone door.

scenes.title: 🕳 The Dark Cave
scenes.narrative:
The cave is completely dark.

💧 Water drips somewhere nearby.

Then you hear breathing.

👁 Two glowing eyes suddenly appear in the darkness.

scenes.title: 💀 The Guardian
scenes.narrative:
A massive skeletal figure slowly steps forward.

⚔️ Instead of attacking, it points toward a hidden passage.

It almost seems to be testing you.

scenes.title: 💰 The Treasure Chamber
scenes.narrative:
You enter a massive chamber overflowing with gold and ancient artifacts.

✨ At the center sits a glowing chest surrounded by piles of treasure.

The air feels… wrong.

scenes.title: ✨ The True Treasure
scenes.narrative:
Inside the chest is not gold… but a glowing artifact.

💡 The moment you touch it, visions flood your mind.

Ancient knowledge.
Forgotten civilizations.
Secrets beyond imagination.

You leave the island forever changed.

scenes.title: ☠️ The Curse
scenes.narrative:
The moment you grab the treasure, the chamber begins to shake.

💀 Your crew slowly transforms into skeletal figures before your eyes.

You realize too late…

The island never guarded the gold.

It guarded the curse.

scenes.title: 🏴‍☠️ The Smart Pirate
scenes.narrative:
You leave the treasure untouched.

🌫 As your ship sails away, the island slowly disappears back into the fog.

Some treasures simply aren't worth the cost.

But you survived to sail another day.

scenes.title: 🌊 The Escape
scenes.narrative:
You abandon the island and sail back into open waters.

🏝 Whatever secrets the island held remain hidden forever.

But at least you escaped alive.

scenes.title: ⚓ Turning Back
scenes.narrative:
You decide the island is not worth the risk.

🌊 Your ship disappears into the fog as the cursed island fades behind you.

Its secrets remain unsolved forever.

scenes.title: ⚠️ The Trap
scenes.narrative:
You force the stone door open.

🏹 Arrows fire from hidden holes in the walls.

The ruins begin collapsing around you.

The island claims another victim.

scenes.title: ☠️ Lost to the Island
scenes.narrative:
Whatever lurked in the darkness attacks without warning.

🌑 Your screams vanish into the cave.

You never escape the cursed island.
